Dave Matthews Band
June 1, 2024
Dos Equis Pavilion - Dallas, TX

*=*=*=*=* 16/48 RECORDING *=*=*=*=*
*=* NOT SUITABLE FOR CD BURNING *=*
*=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=*

Taper: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLS (Hypercardioid) > MixPre 10 II (32 Bit Float @ 96)
Location: Front House Left of FOH, Left of DFC, Mics ORFT @ ~11'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 7.16 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Resample 24/48) > Audacity 3.5.1 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

18. Everyday⁴ >
19. Ants Marching⁵

21. Some Devil⁶
22. All Along the Watchtower⁷

Set Time: [02:36:53.702]

Dave Matthews Band:

¹ improv intro

Huge thank you to the DMB Road Crew for being so supportive of live taping.

This recording is dedicated to all the tapers that have taught me to love archiving live music.
